007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude;
010import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnore;
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
012import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies;
013
014import java.util.List;
015
016/**
017 * Attributes used to create or update a Select AI Agent tool.
018 * <p>
019 * {@code toolParams} uses immutable {@link ToolParams} models, such as
020 * {@link SqlToolParams}. {@code toolInputs} uses an immutable list of
021 * {@link ToolInput} entries containing input names and descriptions.
022 * The builder snapshots both when supplied, so later changes to caller-owned
023 * collections cannot change the configuration or JSON sent to the database.
024 * Additional tool parameters are preserved when loading database metadata;
025 * unrecognized parameter schemas use {@link GenericToolParams}.
026 * The database validates whether the attributes are semantically valid for the
027 * selected tool type and database release.
028 *
029 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolSample.html">
030 *      CreateToolSample source</a>
031 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SetToolAttributesSample.html">
032 *      SetToolAttributesSample source</a>
033 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolParamsSample.html">
034 *      ToolParamsSample source</a>
035 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
036 *      ToolInputSample source</a>
037 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolWithInputsSample.html">
038 *      CreateToolWithInputsSample source</a>
039 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SetToolInputsSample.html">
040 *      SetToolInputsSample source</a>
041 * @since 1.1.0
042 */
043public final class ToolAttributes {
044    /** Configured once and never mutated; retains explicit nulls within parameter maps. */
045    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper()
046            .setPropertyNamingStrategy(PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
047            .setDefaultPropertyInclusion(JsonInclude.Value.construct(
048                    JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL, JsonInclude.Include.ALWAYS));
049
050    /** Tool instruction sent to the model. */
051    private final String instruction;
052    /** PL/SQL function or procedure used by a custom tool. */
053    private final String function;
054    /** Built-in or database-defined tool type. */
055    private final ToolType toolType;
056    /** Immutable typed built-in tool parameters. */
057    private final ToolParams toolParams;
058    /** Immutable input metadata, or null when not supplied. */
059    private final List<ToolInput> toolInputs;
060
061    private ToolAttributes(Builder builder) {
062        this.instruction = builder.instruction;
063        this.function = builder.functionName;
064        this.toolType = builder.toolType;
065        this.toolParams = builder.toolParams;
066        this.toolInputs = builder.toolInputs;
067    }
068
069    /**
070     * Returns the tool instruction.
071     *
072     * @return tool instruction, or {@code null} when unset
073     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/LoadToolSample.html">
074     *      LoadToolSample source</a>
075     */
076    public String getInstruction() {
077        return instruction;
078    }
079
080    /**
081     * Returns the custom PL/SQL function or procedure name.
082     *
083     * @return function or procedure name, or {@code null} when unset
084     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/LoadToolSample.html">
085     *      LoadToolSample source</a>
086     */
087    public String getFunction() {
088        return function;
089    }
090
091    /**
092     * Returns the built-in or database-defined tool type.
093     * <p>
094     * The returned {@link ToolType} preserves a value introduced by a newer
095     * database release, even when this SDK does not yet define a named constant
096     * for it.
097     *
098     * @return tool type, or {@code null} when unset
099     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/LoadToolSample.html">
100     *      LoadToolSample source</a>
101     */
102    public ToolType getToolType() {
103        return toolType;
104    }
105
106    /**
107     * Returns the raw database tool type value.
108     *
109     * @return database tool type value, or {@code null} when unset
110     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/LoadToolSample.html">
111     *      LoadToolSample source</a>
112     */
113    @JsonIgnore
114    public String getToolTypeValue() {
115        return toolType == null ? null : toolType.getValue();
116    }
117
118    /**
119     * Returns typed built-in tool parameters, including additional database fields.
120     * Use {@link ToolParams#toMap()} for a complete immutable parameter map.
121     *
122     * @return immutable tool parameters, or {@code null} when unset
123     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/LoadToolSample.html">
124     *      LoadToolSample source</a>
125     */
126    public ToolParams getToolParams() {
127        return toolParams;
128    }
129
130    /**
131     * Returns immutable tool input metadata in the supplied or database order.
132     *
133     * @return immutable tool input metadata, or {@code null} when unset
134     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/LoadToolSample.html">
135     *      LoadToolSample source</a>
136     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
137     *      ToolInputSample source</a>
138     */
139    public List<ToolInput> getToolInputs() {
140        return toolInputs;
141    }
142
143    /**
144     * Creates a builder for tool attributes.
145     *
146     * @return mutable builder for tool attributes
147     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolWithInputsSample.html">
148     *      CreateToolWithInputsSample source</a>
149     */
150    public static Builder builder() {
151        return new Builder();
152    }
153
154    /**
155     * Serializes attributes using the snake-case names expected by
156     * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT}.
157     *
158     * Null attributes and unset input fields are omitted; explicit null values
159     * inside parameter maps are retained.
160     *
161     * @return JSON object containing non-null attributes
162     * @throws IllegalStateException when the attributes cannot be serialized
163     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
164     *      ToolInputSample source</a>
165     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolParamsSample.html">
166     *      ToolParamsSample source</a>
167     */
168    public String toJson() {
169        try {
170            return MAPPER.writeValueAsString(this);
171        } catch (Exception e) {
172            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to serialize ToolAttributes", e);
173        }
174    }
175
176    /**
177     * Builder for {@link ToolAttributes}.
178     *
179     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolWithInputsSample.html">
180     *      CreateToolWithInputsSample source</a>
181     */
182    public static final class Builder {
183        /** Tool instruction sent to the model. */
184        private String instruction;
185        /** Custom PL/SQL function or procedure name. */
186        private String functionName;
187        /** Built-in or database-defined tool type. */
188        private ToolType toolType;
189        /** Immutable typed built-in tool parameters. */
190        private ToolParams toolParams;
191        /** Immutable snapshot of tool input metadata. */
192        private List<ToolInput> toolInputs;
193
194        /**
195         * Sets the tool instruction.
196         *
197         * @param instruction tool instruction
198         * @return this builder
199         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolWithInputsSample.html">
200         *      CreateToolWithInputsSample source</a>
201         */
202        public Builder instruction(String instruction) {
203            this.instruction = instruction;
204            return this;
205        }
206
207        /**
208         * Sets the custom PL/SQL function or procedure name.
209         *
210         * @param functionName function or procedure name
211         * @return this builder
212         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolWithInputsSample.html">
213         *      CreateToolWithInputsSample source</a>
214         */
215        public Builder function(String functionName) {
216            this.functionName = functionName;
217            return this;
218        }
219
220        /**
221         * Sets a known or database-defined tool type.
222         *
223         * @param toolType tool type value object
224         * @return this builder
225         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateSqlToolSample.html">
226         *      CreateSqlToolSample source</a>
227         */
228        public Builder toolType(ToolType toolType) {
229            this.toolType = toolType;
230            return this;
231        }
232
233        /**
234         * Sets a tool type directly from its database value.
235         *
236         * @param toolType database tool type value
237         * @return this builder
238         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when {@code toolType} is blank
239         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolSample.html">
240         *      CreateToolSample source</a>
241         */
242        public Builder toolTypeValue(String toolType) {
243            this.toolType = toolType == null ? null : ToolType.of(toolType);
244            return this;
245        }
246
247        /**
248         * Snapshots typed built-in tool parameters. Use a tool-specific builder
249         * for known fields or {@link GenericToolParams} for an extensible
250         * parameter object. Required fields are validated by the database.
251         *
252         * @param toolParams tool parameters, or null to omit them
253         * @return this builder
254         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the value is not JSON-compatible
255         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateSqlToolSample.html">
256         *      CreateSqlToolSample source</a>
257         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SetSqlToolParamsSample.html">
258         *      SetSqlToolParamsSample source</a>
259         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolParamsSample.html">
260         *      ToolParamsSample source</a>
261         */
262        public Builder toolParams(ToolParams toolParams) {
263            this.toolParams = ToolParamsSupport.copy(toolParams);
264            return this;
265        }
266
267        /**
268         * Copies tool input metadata into an immutable list. Each entry supplies
269         * a name and optional description; the database validates their meaning.
270         * An empty list is serialized as an empty {@code tool_inputs} array.
271         *
272         * @param toolInputs input metadata, or {@code null} to omit it
273         * @return this builder
274         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the list contains a null entry
275         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
276         *      ToolInputSample source</a>
277         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolSample.html">
278         *      CreateToolSample source</a>
279         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolWithInputsSample.html">
280         *      CreateToolWithInputsSample source</a>
281         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SetToolInputsSample.html">
282         *      SetToolInputsSample source</a>
283         */
284        public Builder toolInputs(List<ToolInput> toolInputs) {
285            if (toolInputs == null) {
286                this.toolInputs = null;
287            } else {
288                try {
289                    this.toolInputs = List.copyOf(toolInputs);
290                } catch (NullPointerException e) {
291                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("toolInputs must not contain null entries", e);
292                }
293            }
294            return this;
295        }
296
297        /**
298         * Builds immutable tool attributes.
299         *
300         * @return immutable tool attributes
301         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolWithInputsSample.html">
302         *      CreateToolWithInputsSample source</a>
303         */
304        public ToolAttributes build() {
305            return new ToolAttributes(this);
306        }
307    }
308}
